limitations: Statuses describe the existing prototype, not equivalence to the original.
Test references identify scope, not proof of arbitrary Windows compatibility.
The complete product is not independent of external engines.
References and hashes establish provenance, not semantic correctness.
No behavioral-equivalence percentage is computed from control counts.
